question: What powers arise from the practice described to the beloved?
premises: One attainment is knowledge of distant hearing.
Another attainment is the paralysis of bonds.
inference: The practitioner gains knowledge of distant hearing and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
uncertainties: pāśa-stobham may refer to immobilizing fetters or enemies.
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of hearing from afar and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
